name: Triage Improvement Suggestion
description: Investigate a fleet agent's improvement suggestion, classify it, and execute the right improvement process.

steps.title: Read suggestion and mission history
steps.description: Read the improvement suggestion from the delegation instruction. Extract the referenced mission ID. Using work-management skill, read the referenced mission's full work tree — all M/C/T envelopes, their statuses, outputs, verdicts, iteration counts, and telemetry entries. Understand: what the mission tried to do, what succeeded, what failed, how many envelopes were created, and how long it took.
steps.accept_criteria: Written summary: what the mission did, what went wrong or was suboptimal, what the user specifically suggested, and the mission's key metrics (envelope count, duration, failure points).

steps.title: Classify into improvement module(s)
steps.description: Based on the evidence, classify the improvement into one or more of the 8 modules. Read the architect-prime project context for module definitions. The 8 modules are: (1) Daemons — control flow bug, crash, stuck loop, ceremony divergence. (2) Organ SOULs — bad decisions, plan inflation, false verdicts, wrong agent assignments. (3) Context & Memory — stale/missing project context, memory recall failures. (4) Neural Gateway — high token cost, low cache rate, loop guard issues. (5) Work Layer — missing process, bad process steps, low process coverage. (6) Skills — missing procedures, wrong syntax, low success rate. (7) Dashboard & Bootstrap — missing UI features, deployment friction. (8) Delegation & Cross-Agent — delegation storms, cross-agent context failures, delegation instruction quality. Report the module(s) and the specific finding for each.
steps.accept_criteria: At least one module identified with specific evidence. If multiple modules, they are prioritized by impact.

steps.title: Execute improvement process(es)
steps.description: For each identified module, follow the corresponding improvement process: p-improve-daemons, p-improve-souls, p-improve-context, p-improve-gateway, p-improve-work-layer, p-improve-skills, p-improve-dashboard, or p-improve-delegation. The process defines the evidence→plan→execute→verify cycle. If the improvement involves code/content changes to the repo, stage the changes locally.
steps.accept_criteria: Improvement executed per the process. Changed files listed. Before/after metrics documented.

steps.title: Submit changes
steps.description: If the improvement produced repo file changes: using git-ops skill, create a feature branch named 'improve/{module}-{short-desc}', commit all changes with a descriptive message, push, and open a pull request to main. The PR description must include: what was improved, which module, evidence, and before/after metrics. If the improvement was data-only (project context, core memory, process in Firestore): no PR needed — the changes are already persisted.
steps.accept_criteria: PR opened (if code changes) or Firestore updated (if data changes). Link provided.

steps.title: Report back
steps.description: Compose a summary for the fleet agent's delegation result: what the user suggested, what was investigated, what was improved, what the user should expect to see differently. Keep it concise — the user is not an engineer.
steps.accept_criteria: Summary delivered via delegation result. Understandable without reading the PR.
